prompt_text: What are the best online courses for learning shadow work and spiritual practice?
engine_stated_criteria: Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self
answer_verbatim:
If you want the **best online courses** for shadow work and spiritual practice, the strongest options in the results are **Jung Platform’s *Encounters with the Shadow***, **Charlie Morley’s *Embracing the Shadow***, and **ManTalks’ *Shadow Course***.[2][7][17] For a more beginner-friendly or lower-cost route, several Udemy shadow-work courses also look practical, especially those with guided exercises, workbooks, meditations, and structured lesson plans.[3][12][13][14]

A useful way to choose is by *depth vs. accessibility*:

| Course | Best for | Why it stands out |
|---|---|---|
| **Encounters with the Shadow** (Jung Platform) | Learners who want a Jungian foundation | It is explicitly framed as an in-depth introduction to Jungian shadow work and part of a broader Jungian psychology series.[7][11] |
| **Embracing the Shadow** (Awake Academy / Charlie Morley) | Spiritual practice plus transformation | It is presented as a transformative course focused on shadow integration and relationship impact.[17] |
| **Shadow Course** (ManTalks) | Structured guided process | It offers an 8-week guided process for facing and integrating the shadow.[16] |
| **Shadow Work: Heal & Integrate your Shadow Self** (Udemy) | Practical self-study | It emphasizes hidden gifts, self-mastery, and spiritual awakening.[3] |
| **Shadow Work Course and Workbook** (Udemy) | Hands-on exercises | It includes lessons, exercises, diagrams, meditations, prayers, and practices for introspection and spiritual transformation.[12] |
| **Shadow Work Essentials** (Udemy) | Basics and techniques | It focuses on techniques for uncovering and healing shamed or exiled parts of the psyche.[13] |

If you want the **most academically grounded** option, start with **Jung Platform** because it is explicitly tied to Jungian psychology and includes broader shadow-related courses and talks.[2][7][11] If you want the **most explicitly spiritual** option, **Charlie Morley’s course** and the **Udemy courses that mention meditation, prayers, and spiritual transformation** are the best matches in the results.[12][14][17]

A few practical selection tips:
- Choose a course that clearly says it includes **exercises, journaling, meditations, or guided reflection** if you want actual practice rather than theory.[12][16][20]
- Prefer courses that specify a **structured format** like 5 weeks or 8 weeks if you want accountability and progression.[6][16]
- If you are new to shadow work, start with **introductory/Jungian courses** rather than advanced facilitator trainings.[7][8]

One caution: shadow work can bring up intense emotions, so it is worth choosing a course that emphasizes reflection and integration rather than just “breakthrough” claims.[20] If you want, I can also narrow this down to **the best free options**, **the best beginner courses**, or **the best spiritually focused courses only**.
